download_dir.description: The default directory where downloaded files are saved.

aria2_rpc_secret.description: Secret token for authenticating with the aria2 RPC interface.

aria2_rpc_host.description: The hostname or IP address where aria2 RPC service is listening.

aria2_rpc_port.description: The port number where aria2 RPC service is listening.

max_connection_per_server.description: Maximum number of connections to one server for each download.

max_concurrent_downloads.description: Maximum number of concurrent downloads per task.

user_agent.description: User-Agent header to send for HTTP(S) downloads.

split.description: Whether to split files into multiple connections to increase download speed.

check_certificate.description: Whether to check the certificate of HTTPS servers.

aria2_dir.description: Directory where aria2 stores session data and configuration files.
